summary_en: Topre raises interim dividend by 10 yen to 60 yen per share and revises fiscal year-end dividend guidance upward by 15 yen to 65 yen, bringing annual dividend to 125 yen per share, up 25 yen from prior guidance.
title_en: Notice Regarding Surplus Distribution (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Fiscal Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Topre Corporation's Board of Directors resolved to increase the interim dividend effective December 11, 2026. The interim dividend per share rises 10 yen to 60 yen from the prior guidance of 50 yen, with a total payout of 2,930 million yen. The company simultaneously revised upward its fiscal year-end dividend forecast by 15 yen to 65 yen per share, bringing the full-year dividend to 125 yen, up 25 yen from the previous guidance of 100 yen.

The increases reflect Topre's medium-term dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 20–30 percent, with a longer-term target of 30 percent or more. The company aims to strengthen total shareholder returns through both cash dividends and share buyback programs, while maintaining a stable operational foundation. The interim dividend is paid from retained earnings as of the record date of September 30, 2026.
